name: Professional Portfolio
des: A comprehensive professional portfolio engineered as a modern React web application. It serves as a central hub for showcasing front-end architecture projects, interactive design systems, and technical case studies, utilizing modular components and responsive design to deliver an optimized user experience across devices.
mission: Architect a scalable, high-performance personal platform to effectively communicate complex engineering capabilities, design system expertise, and professional achievements.

name: Course Directory
des: A modular, data-driven course management application built to demonstrate advanced React routing and state management patterns. It features a dynamic directory interface that allows users to navigate, filter, and access detailed course information, highlighting effective component composition and clean, maintainable code architecture.
mission: Develop a performant, scalable directory interface utilizing modern React patterns to streamline content discovery and user navigation.
technology: React.js, React Router, JavaScript (ES6+), CSS3, HTML5

name: Gif Generator App
des: An interactive GIF discovery application powered by the Giphy API. Users can search for and browse animated GIFs through a responsive grid interface, demonstrating real-time API integration, efficient rendering of media assets, and a clean, engaging user experience.
mission: Build a fast, delightful GIF search experience that showcases API consumption, responsive media handling, and intuitive search UX in a React application.
technology: React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), Giphy API, HTML5, CSS3

name: Arya's List Of Names
des: A Game of Thrones themed interactive scoring application built with React. Users can add names to Arya's list, increment kill counts for characters, and track a running total score alongside a built-in stopwatch for timed challenges, demonstrating state management, dynamic list rendering, and playful UI interactions.
mission: Create an engaging, thematic React application that demonstrates component state, list manipulation, and real-time score tracking in a fun, recognizable context.

name: Wedding
des: A fully-featured Angular wedding website for a 2018 Cincinnati wedding, featuring an elegant multi-section layout with Our Story, Wedding Party, Location details with embedded maps, Registry links, RSVP form integration, Hotel booking information, a live countdown timer, and a parallax-enhanced footer. The site demonstrates component architecture, lazy-loaded imagery, and polished visual storytelling.
mission: Design and develop a beautiful, informative wedding website that guides guests through the event details while showcasing front-end craftsmanship with Angular, SCSS, and interactive effects.
technology: Angular, TypeScript, SCSS, Bootstrap, Lazy Loading, Parallax.js, HTML5
